name: directus-extension-decrement-inventory-stock
description: Directus Flow operation: atomically decrement catalog.inventory.stock for a list of {bookId, quantity} line items, inside a single DB transaction, gated by a shared secret (not Directus's own accountability/role system - this runs with Directus's own DB connection regardless of caller identity, same as promote-staging-book). Triggered by a webhook Flow - see ../../../scripts/bootstrap.ts's ensureInventoryDecrementFlow() and packages/contracts/src/events.ts's InventoryDecrementRequestedEvent for the callers (apps/api-commerce's inventory-sync-consumer Lambda, apps/medusa's store-order creation route).
